title: Is Instinct safe to use? Three things to know before you sign up

reading.body:
Instinct is an AI personal assistant that uses personal data to train its models by default, requiring users to opt out rather than opt in. The system processes information about browsing habits, location, health, finances, and political views without direct authorization for each use. This represents a deployment choice to collect and use personal data without explicit consent at the point of use.

The system can make purchases on users' behalf through shared payment methods, placing the burden of dispute on the user rather than on Instinct. Even when users disconnect connected accounts, the system retains previously indexed data and maintains copies of information such as emails. These design choices mean the system continues to hold and potentially use personal information even after a user attempts to limit its access.

It is not established whether these practices violate any law, whether users actually understood the terms they agreed to, or what proportion of users are aware of the opt-out requirement before data collection begins.

summary:
# Summary

Instinct is a new AI personal assistant that has gained popularity in Silicon Valley, but it presents significant privacy and security risks. By default, unless users opt out, Instinct uses personal information to train its AI models, meaning data about browsing habits, location, health, finances, and political views could be shared without direct authorization. Additionally, even when users disconnect connected accounts like Google, Instinct retains previously indexed data and continues storing copies of information such as emails.

The assistant can also make purchases on users' behalf through shared payment methods, and any unintended purchases become the user's responsibility to dispute directly with merchants rather than with Instinct. Norton positions its Family Assistant as a safer alternative, emphasizing that it keeps user data private, does not train external AI models with personal information, and requires explicit user confirmation before taking actions like submitting forms or booking appointments.
